title: Rockefeller's panel meets at Quantico

tellings.quote: The group first met at Quantico, Virginia to draft reports for Eisenhower.

plain: In 1955, a panel led by Nelson Rockefeller, then an adviser to President Dwight Eisenhower, is said to have first met at Quantico, a Marine Corps base in Virginia, to draft reports for Eisenhower. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode asking whether Henry Kissinger, who later became Secretary of State, oversaw a program recovering crashed UFOs. In his telling, the group was an early link between these men and the secret UFO question.
